summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stripe integration for CapyMatch subscription tiers. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UpgradeModal and PaymentSuccess page working correctly. Fixed one price display bug in AccountPage.js.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Hardcoded prices showed $19/$39 instead of $29/$49

critical_code_review_comments: Backend Stripe integration using emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout is correctly implemented
PLAN_PRICES in stripe.py ($29, $49) now correctly match SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS in subscriptions.py
Checkout session creates pending transaction in payment_transactions collection
Status endpoint correctly polls Stripe and updates plan on payment success
Webhook at /api/webhook/stripe provides backup plan upgrade processing
UpgradeModal correctly displays all 3 tiers with correct prices (Free, $29, $49)
PaymentSuccess page correctly handles: no session, polling, confirmed, and failed states
All data-testid attributes present: tier-card-{id}, tier-upgrade-{id}, tier-current-{id}, upgrade-modal, payment-success-page, etc.
